summary: Client-only (registry size 32 on the client row, none on the server). Created by gui::lariannet::AuthorisationSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x12E1650, creator bg3.exe+0x12E2000) on a new entity when the Larian.net login state reported by FUN_1412E1470 changes; the same update then calls AuthorisationSystem::LoggedOff(view) when +0 is false, or AuthorisationSystem::LoggedOn(view, STDString const&) with +8 when it is true, which set the VMGameData properties LarianNetIsConnected / LarianNetUserName. Not saved.

fields.name: LoggedIn
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x12E1650 line 141: *comp = byte from FUN_1412E1470 (copied from the login record's +0 when its +1 is set); line 264: if *comp == 0 -> AuthorisationSystem::LoggedOff, else LoggedOn. Creator writes 0.

fields.name: _Pad1
fields.evidence: creator zeroes +0..+7 as one qword; padding before the string

fields.name: UserName
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x12E2000: +8 byte 0, +0x18 size 0, +0x1C capacity 0xF (small-string ls::STDString, 24 bytes); destructor FUN_1405CDB20 frees +8 when capacity > 15. Line 142-148: STDString::STDString(comp+8, name); passed to AuthorisationSystem::LoggedOn, which fills the VMGameData property c_LarianNetUserNameId (named macOS signature).
